localStaging.method: Unchanged production prepareBuildProject regenerated after the host hint and World worker-scope fixes; changed entries written with production writeBuildEntry, all entries verified at concurrency16. Its source guard rejected a concurrent World file-count admission cap change. A fresh-policy equivalence check regenerated both bundled workers byte-for-byte, proved the only policy-object difference was the un-serialized admission cap, and independently rehashed all entries. Omits only distribution.zip and checksum discarded by publish-main-pages.

interruptedStandardBuild.reason: Sequential network-volume staging projected another 45–55 minutes after 747 files; stopped before starting equivalent bounded-concurrency staging.

exactDelta.comment: Includes World's same-scope Advanced worker bootstrap.

policyEquivalence.scope: Fresh final-policy buildBundledOptionalPractice calls against all final staged dependencies regenerated both offline workers byte-for-byte. In the bundled production path limits.files is used only for admission; it is absent from returned files/revision/entries. All published bytes were independently rehashed after this comparison. Standalone optional/native package metadata is a different output and was rebuilt separately.

capacity.note: Distribution ZIP and its checksum are excluded exactly as in publish-main-pages. This forecasts the empty optional selector. Actual final staging inventory and uploaded archive must still pass the unchanged CI gates.

sourceBinding: Local generated working-tree build; final committed CI build must be checked separately.
authentication: Fresh locked gate verified. Then a disposable local browser profile uses the same remembered-unlock fixture as access-gate tests. Production HTML, scripts, and verifier are unchanged; no real-password acceptance is claimed.
limits: Chrome on one local host, HTTP localhost secure context; not a public HTTPS deployment test.
Offline preparation uses the production installation API; this is not an installer button/accessibility acceptance test.
Each package has an isolated browser context. Offline reload/re-entry is tested; browser-process restart and storage eviction are not.
The declared lazy main-game tools extension is outside optional offline packages; its exact unavailable request and user-facing fallback are checked separately.
Advanced remains experimental and unscored; no performance, device, Regional scene, or competition qualification is inferred.
